goal: Make the governed review consumer preserve precise terminal failure reasons, reject fake approval from failed wrappers, and pass the exact governed head to DeepSeek without changing database state.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan (owner approval in the active #159 continuation)
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or reviewer-assignment write.
Do not accept APPROVE output from a wrapper whose process failed.
Do not expose raw provider stderr, prompts, credentials, or private evidence in public output.
Do not widen provider limits or retry historical failed paid turns.
assumptions: Toolkit #394 lands stable reason tokens for Qwen content inspection, Muse startup or management failure, and Grok provider cancellation versus turn-limit cancellation.
DeepSeek send and reply accept the governed-verdict head contract already implemented by its wrapper.
This repository-maintenance change owns no database object and requires no migration-author route.
stop_conditions: Stop if the toolkit terminal tokens change before this consumer lands.
Stop if completion requires any file outside the two governed-review files and the evidence pair.
Stop if tests cannot prove failed wrappers remain non-authorizing and raw diagnostics remain private.
